Since we want to find the value of $y$ and $z$ at $x=2,$ we will use a step size of

$$
Δx=2-0=2.
$$

| $x$ | $y$ | ${y}^{′}$ | $Δy$ | $z$ | ${z}^{′}$ | $Δz$ |
